description: This file defines internal data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for managing schedule tables in an AUTOSAR-based real-time operating system, including expiry points, synchronization strategies, autostart configurations, and accessors.

methods.name: Os_SchTblCalcExpire
methods.description: Calculates expiry for a schedule table.

methods.name: Os_SchTblCheck
methods.description: Checks schedule table status against a counter.

methods.name: Os_SchTblAutostart
methods.description: Starts schedule tables based on autostart configuration.

methods.name: Os_SchTblGet
methods.description: Retrieves a schedule table by ID.

methods.name: Os_SchTblGetInitialOffset
methods.description: Gets the initial expiry offset of a schedule table.

methods.name: Os_SchTblGetFinalOffset
methods.description: Gets the final expiry offset of a schedule table.

methods.name: Os_SchTblGetApplicationOwner
methods.description: Returns the application owner of a schedule table.

methods.name: getAdjExpPoint
methods.description: Accessor for adjusted expiry point parameters.

methods.name: getSync
methods.description: Accessor for schedule table synchronization data.
